brief.title: FDA Metformin Recalls and Research Gap on Longevity
brief.summary: The FDA has reported several Class II recalls of metformin extended‑release tablets and combination products, mainly for NDMA contamination, foreign tablets, CGMP deviations, and stainless‑steel particulates. No recent research on metformin and longevity appears in the supplied evidence.

points.text: Multiple Class II recalls for metformin ER tablets due to NDMA levels above the acceptable daily intake.
Recalls for metformin ER tablets containing foreign tablets such as paracetamol.
A recall for metformin ER tablets due to CGMP deviations without a specified contaminant.
A recall for metformin ER tablets because of stainless steel particulates.
